paper.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
truncated_sections: B.5 Performance Variance and Pass@k Rate

result.summary: 本文提出 SWE-agent，一个由语言模型（LM）与 agent-computer interface（ACI）组成的系统，用于自主解决软件工程任务 [S1.p3]。作者认为 LM agent 是一类新的终端用户，需要专门设计的接口，因此设计了包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件的 ACI [S2.p1][S3.p1]。在 SWE-bench 和 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 分别取得 12.5% 和 87.7% 的 pass@1 成绩，超过此前非交互式 LM 的最好结果 [abstract]。作者还通过消融研究分析了 ACI 设计选择对 agent 行为和性能的影响 [S1.p4][S5.SS1.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：如何为 LM agent 设计合适的接口，使其能完成软件工程这类复杂任务 [S1.p1]。作者指出，LM agent 通常直接使用 Linux shell 或 Python 解释器等现有应用，但在实践中 LM agent 难以可靠地在 shell 环境中行动，例如无法提供编辑小段文件的简单命令，且对无效编辑不给出反馈 [S1.p2]。作者认为 LM agent 代表一类新的终端用户，具有自身需求与能力，因此需要专门的 agent-computer interface [S2.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, applying agents to more complex code tasks like software engineering remains unexplored.
we investigate whether LM agents could similarly benefit from better-designed interfaces for performing software engineering tasks.
In practice, we find that LM agents can struggle to reliably take actions in this environment.
For example, it fails to provide simple commands to edit a small file segment, and does not provide any feedback if the user makes an invalid edit.
We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.

method.text: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 和 ACI 组成的 agent，可与计算机交互解决真实软件工程问题 [S1.p3]。其 ACI 提供一小组简单动作用于查看、搜索和编辑文件，并设置 guardrails 防止常见错误，每一步都向 agent 返回具体简洁的反馈 [S1.p3]。ACI 包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器、上下文管理等组件，基于 Linux shell 构建，同时允许访问常用 Linux 命令 [S3.p1]。设计过程采用两种方式：人工检查 agent 行为以发现问题并提出改进，以及在开发集上运行网格搜索选择最佳 ACI 配置 [S2.p4]。

evidence.quote: we introduce SWE-agent, an agent composed of an LM and ACI, that can interact with a computer to solve challenging real-world software engineering problems
SWE-agent’s ACI instead offers a small set of simple actions for viewing, searching through and editing files.
The ACI uses guardrails to prevent common mistakes, and an agent receives specific, concise feedback about a command’s effects at every turn.
The ACI comprises several principal components, including search/navigation, file viewer, file editor, and context management.
Built atop the Linux shell, SWE-agent also allows access to common Linux commands and utilities when needed.

We use two approaches to enhance performance on a development set: (1) manually inspect agent behavior to identify difficulties and propose improvements, and (2) run a grid search to select the best ACI configuration.

experiments.text: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包仓库的 2,294 个任务实例；消融和分析在 SWE-bench Lite 上进行，这是包含 300 个实例的规范子集，聚焦自包含的功能性 bug 修复 [S4.p1]。此外还用 HumanEvalFix 测试基本代码编辑能力 [S4.p1]。所有结果、消融和分析基于 GPT-4 Turbo 和 Claude 3 Opus 两个 LM [S4.p2]。对比基线包括非交互式检索增强生成（RAG）和仅使用 Linux shell 的 Shell-only 设置 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。主要指标为 % Resolved 或 pass@1，并报告平均 API 推理成本，单实例预算设为 4 美元 [S4.p5]。

evidence.quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
SWE-bench Lite is a canonical subset of $300$ instances from SWE-bench that focus on evaluating self-contained functional bug fixes.
We also test SWE-agent’s basic code editing abilities with HumanEvalFix, a short-form code debugging benchmark.
All results, ablations, and analyses are based on two leading LMs, GPT-4 Turbo ( gpt-4-1106-preview) and Claude 3 Opus ( claude-3-opus-20240229).
The first setting is the non-interactive, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baselines established in.
The second setting, called Shell-only, is adapted from the interactive coding framework introduced in.
We report % Resolved or pass $@$ $1$ as the main metric
Due to budget constraints, we set the per-instance budget to $4; if a run exceeded this budget, existing edits were submitted automatically.

findings.text: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo 在所有系统中表现最佳，解决完整 SWE-bench 测试集的 12.47%（286/2,294）和 Lite 子集的 18.00%（54/300）[S5.p1]。相比 Lite 上的 RAG，SWE-agent 成本高 8–13 倍，但 % Resolved 率提升 6.7 倍；相比同样使用 GPT-4 Turbo 的 Shell-only，相对提升 64% [S5.p1]。在 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 取得 88.3% 的 pass@1 率 [S5.p2]。消融显示，使用迭代搜索接口时性能反而比没有额外搜索工具更差（15.7% 降至 12.0%）[S5.SS1.p3]；没有文件编辑器接口时性能降至 10.3% [S5.SS1.p4]；没有 linting 时性能为 15.0% [S5.SS1.p5]。行为分析发现，agent 通常先复现和/或定位问题，之后主要是“编辑再执行”循环 [S5.SS2.p2][S5.SS2.p3]；编辑仍然困难，51.7% 的轨迹有至少一次失败编辑 [S5.SS2.p4]；成功运行比失败运行完成更早、成本更低 [S5.SS2.p5]；约一半（52.0%）未解决实例属于错误实现或过度特定实现 [S5.SS2.p6]。

evidence.quote: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2,294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
compared to RAG on Lite, SWE-agent is $8$ - $13$ x more costly but yields a $6.7$ -fold improved % Resolved rate.
An LM-friendly ACI’s value is confirmed by SWE-agent’s $64$ % relative increase compared to Shell-only, both with GPT-4 Turbo.
SWE-agent yields strong performance on HumanEvalFix with $88.3$ % pass@1 rate.
leading to even worse performance than the not having additional search tools at all ( $15.7$ % $\downarrow$ 2.3 for No search vs. $12.0$ % $\downarrow$ 6.0 with Iterative search).
Without SWE-agent’s file editor interface, performance drops to ( $10.3$ % $\downarrow$ 7.7).
This intervention improves performance considerably (without linting, $15.0$ % $\downarrow$ 3.0).
SWE-agent usually begins with either writing reproduction code and/or localizing the issue’s cause to specific lines of code.
from turn $5$ onwards, the most frequent two actions for all turns are edit and python.
out of $2,294$ task instances, $1,185$ ( $51.7$ %) of SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo trajectories have $1$ + failed edits.
We observe that successful runs complete earlier and at a cheaper cost than unsuccessful ones.
about half ( $52.0$ %) of unresolved instances fall into the Incorrect Implementation or Overly Specific Implementation categories
